description: Dataset-specialized columnar codec for the Yelp business JSONL. Fixed JSON template text is fused around per-field value streams; IDs stored as base64-decoded 16-byte values and re-encoded in the decoder; attributes/categories/hours encoded as dictionary-id streams (3414 (key,value) pairs, 1299 categories, 9306 day-time slots); city+state+ZIP as a tuple dictionary. All streams zstd-22. Decoder reconstructs rows with a single fused piece-copy pass. Decoder uses pinned libzstd.so.1/libbrotlidec.so.1/libbrotlicommon.so.1.
name: yelp-columnar-fused-v1
